video_title: Luka's Lakers or Wemby's Spurs 🤔 + Dejounte Murray requests trade from NOLA 👀 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Mark Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Pelicans disappointed by Dejounte Murray's public trade request
quotes.excerpt: they're disappointed that he went public with this trade request
quotes.quote: First of all, they're disappointed that he went public with this trade request. Dejounte is not with the team in New Orleans, not practicing. He has an ankle injury right now, recovering from this ankle injury, so it's going to take some time. They're trying their best without him and the thing is, it's not a big market for him right now. Teams typically don't make trades in November and December and right now, the only team that's showing some interest is the Phoenix Suns and it's mild interest at best.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Dejounte Murray's trade request lacks leverage for a return
quotes.excerpt: if you're going to make a trade demand, you should have to have demand for your services
quotes.quote: If you're going to make a trade demand, you should have to have demand for your services. There's really not much. It's a lukewarm market at best. The player option next season is not considered to be attractive for any team that takes him on and the Pelicans have to be very careful here because this is a bad situation. You can't make a trade that makes a bad situation worse. You can't take back a return that's problematic for you in the future.

quotes.speaker: Mark Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Dejounte Murray's frustration with Tony Parker's leadership
quotes.excerpt: Dejounte was disappointed that Tony didn't put his arm around him and show some leadership

text_blocks.speaker: Mark Spears
text_blocks.text: There was a great appearance by Dejounte Murray on All The Smoke podcast where he talked about Tony Parker losing his job to Dejounte and Pop giving the reins to Dejounte. Tony ended up going to Charlotte and not going well there, but he was so upset about losing his starting spot. Dejounte was disappointed that Tony didn't put his arm around him and show some leadership and be the big brother. It's flipped now. Jeremiah Fears in New Orleans is the little guy and he's got the starting position and he took Dejounte's spot and I'm sure Jeremiah wishes that Dejounte put his arm around him in this situation and that's not going to get an opportunity to happen.

text_blocks.speaker: Tim Bontemps
text_blocks.text: It'll be interesting to see how this one shakes out.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' start more impressive than Spurs due to roster turnover
quotes.excerpt: I think you can make a case though this start by the Lakers is more impressive
quotes.quote: I think you can make a case though this start by the Lakers is more impressive. The reason that I say that is the Spurs had continuity. They had their core coming back off of a finals run, whereas this is pretty much a completely renovated supporting cast around Luka Doncic and Austin Reaves. Luka is playing as well as he has in his career, leading this group, and that's the offense in basketball. You see the talent those two have, but you don't necessarily expect them to shoot out of the gates the way that they have with so many new pieces around them.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' fourth-quarter net rating is a major concern
quotes.excerpt: they have one of the worst net ratings in the fourth quarter
quotes.quote: One of the things that's concerning for the Lakers is they have one of the worst net ratings in the fourth quarter. In other words, they're building leads but giving them up and blowing them. Then you have Luka having to come back into games and grabbing the clipboard. You can get away with that against bad teams, but you certainly can't against good ones.

quotes.speaker: Mark Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's potential to match James Harden's scoring records
quotes.excerpt: I think he could be the first player since James Harden to average over 35
quotes.quote: You know what Luka is doing, I think he could be the first player since James Harden to average over 35. But I'm going to go with the mariachi music in San Antonio over the mariachi music in LA. Look, Wembanyama is so grandiose in what he does that their big three guard lineup is certainly being looked at. Fox, Castle, and Harper, and as I mentioned, I think Harper is putting himself in position to be an All-Star.

quotes.speaker: Yaxel Lendeborg
quotes.summary_phrase: Yaxel Lendeborg reflects on Warriors' blowout loss to Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I'm not going to move past this. I don't know about the rest of us.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to move past this. I don't know about the rest of us. Everybody's saying, you know, throw it out the window. I can't throw a damn thing out the window. We just lost by like 100. So, you know, I'm mentally right now. We got a game in two days they said I think, so we'll see how we can bounce back.

quotes.speaker: Anthony Slater
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors need to find wins without Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: they need to find wins without Stephen Curry in the next month or so
quotes.quote: I think it was helpful for them that they got two days off, a rare two days off in the middle of a road trip. George Niang is there and he says Yaxel Lendeborg walks in with his hood on and says, 'Hey, warning, I've cut off my hair.' And I think the veterans and even Steve Kerr joked that maybe that was part of his grieving process of the game the other night. You mentioned 1-13. It was the first game after Stephen Curry was out and I think Yaxel Lendeborg put a bunch of pressure on himself and then didn't deliver in game one. It was a November loss against the best team in the league when you didn't have 150 million in salary. It's okay. They need to find wins without Stephen Curry in the next month or so. At New Orleans is one of the wins you can maybe find.
